text: My daughter, 14 years old, was with her friends yesterday in Mega Mall and ordered a Grand Chicken meal from McDonald’s Mega Mall Sharjah branch. Today morning, she felt a rise in body temperature and dizziness, so I rushed her to the doctor, and after the examination it turned out that she had food poisoning because of the meal that she ate from your branch. Yesterday.! I am her father and I work as an executive chef, and I will take all measures against you 😡
author: mostafa mahmoud

text: My experience at McDonald’s was disappointing. I placed a large order and waited about 10 minutes. Then, the status changed to ‘Now Serving,’ but when I went to pick it up, the staff told me it was a big order. I asked why it was marked as ready if it wasn’t, and instead of answering, she ignored me and started talking to other customers. When I asked again when it would be ready, she continued to ignore me. Extremely unprofessional and frustrating experience.
author: Alice

text: I had an unpleasant experience at McDonald's on the ground floor of Dubai Mall on 21/02/25 at 3:30 PM. When I went to buy ice, two staff members laughed at me for no apparent reason, which felt disrespectful and unprofessional. At the time, I wasn’t sure how to respond, but later, I felt deeply uncomfortable about the situation.
author: Priyanka Srinivasalu

text: I had a disappointing experience at the McDonald's Mega Mall branch. I saw workers drinking and eating while preparing the food, and some of them not wearing gloves. This lack of hygiene is unacceptable and made me concerned about the cleanliness of the entire operation. I hope management addresses these issues promptly.

text: My experience at McDonald's was disappointing. The service was slow, the staff seemed disinterested, and the food was not up to the usual standards – it was cold and lacked freshness.
